Antimatter Capsule (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Antimatter Capsule
Antimatter Capsule (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The majority of enemies will be destroyed immediately due to the enormous amount of energy generated from the annihilation reaction as matter and antimatter collide.

Applied Superconductor (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Applied Superconductor
Applied Superconductor (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
In the field of materials, the emergence of graphene is a
great breakthrough. When stack on layer of graphene
on top on another, afterrotating to a certain Magic
Angel, double-layered graphene will gain
superconductive properties.

Artificial Star (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Artificial Star
Artificial Star (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Energy generated from the destruction caused by colliding positive matter and antimatter can be output to the power grid more stably by containing the reaction inside of an [[Annihilation Constraint Sphere|annihilation constraint sphere]]. The high energy production of this technology makes the core radiation stable in the visible light band which causes the reaction to look like a burning sun.

Attack Drone (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Attack Drone
Attack Drone (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Based on a prototype that is constantly being optimized; more powerful Armor and Weapon systems are equipped to attack enemies nearby and provide powerful support to Icarus on the battlefield.

Automatic Metallurgy (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Automatic Metallurgy
Automatic Metallurgy (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
The invention of Smelter has greatly promoted the
development of metallurgical technology. Using smelter
for automated smelting can improve production
efficiency.

Basic Assembling Processes (Tech)/TechIn.Name: Basic Assembling Processes
Basic Assembling Processes (Tech)/TechIn.Description:
The basic assembler uses traditional mechanical
technology to process primary items into more
advanced ones.

Basic Logistics System (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Basic Logistics System
Basic Logistics System (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Use the {{Glow|Conveyor Belt}} and {{Glow|Sorter}} to transport cargo
from one place to another and to achieve automated
production.

Battlefield Analysis Base (Tech)/TechInf.Name: Battlefield Analysis Base
Battlefield Analysis Base (Tech)/TechInf.Description: We need an autonomous battlefield command and a combat support system when Icarus is away from the base.

Casimir Crystal.Name: Casimir Crystal
Casimir Crystal.Description: Using the force of a strong electric field, a spatial ring crystal can be formed by the Coulomb repulsion between particles. In a weak, static magnetic field the Casimir effect can be observed.
Casimir Crystal.Recipe:
{{ItemRecipe
    |Out1=Crystal Explosive Unit
    |Out1Qty=8
    |CraftTime=24 s
    |In1=Explosive Unit
    |In1Qty=8
    |In2=Casimir Crystal
    |In2Qty=1
    |In3=Crystal Silicon
    |In3Qty=8
  }}

Casimir Crystal (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Casimir Crystal
Casimir Crystal (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Using the force of a strong electric field, a spatial ring crystal can be formed by the Coulomb repulsion between particles. In a weak, static magnetic field the Casimir effect can be observed.

Combustible Unit (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Combustible Unit
Combustible Unit (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Coal can release power more efficiently and powerfully after its molecular geometry has been elaborately modified.

Controlled Annihilation Reaction (Tech)/.Name: Controlled Annihilation Reaction
Controlled Annihilation Reaction (Tech)/.Description: When the matter and antimatter meet they will annihilate mutually and generate tremendous energy. As long as the annihilation process becomes more controllable we will utilize this energy more steadily.

Corvette (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Corvette
Corvette (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Number of Space Fleets +1
Space Fleet Slots +4
As Dark Fog launches raids here and there, the fight is no longer limited to the ground. It's time to deploy space forces!

Crystal Explosive Unit (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Crystal Explosive Unit
Crystal Explosive Unit (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Increasingly intense combats cries for Explosive Units that can inflict both wider and greater damage. Casimir Crystal's special lattice structure can improve the power of Explosive Units and allow them to fracture into sharp shards when sustaining an extreme impact.

Crystal Shell Set (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Crystal Shell Set
Crystal Shell Set (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: High-pressure gases and shock waves resulting from explosions can quickly rupture surrounding materials and turn them into fast-moving shards. Such shards have huge amounts of kinetic energy and can destroy and damage targets in a short time.

Crystal Smelting (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Crystal Smelting
Crystal Smelting (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
With a better understanding of lattice structure and
improved refining technology, we can now use a more
advanced method to smelt high-strength crystals.

Destroyer (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Destroyer
Destroyer (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: We've realized the importance and complexity of Warship from the fights against Dark Fog space forces. Warships require strong power and excellent survival capabilities if they are to help Icarus gain an advantage on the battlefield.

Deuterium Fractionation (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Deuterium Fractionation
Deuterium Fractionation (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
At a certain temperature it is possible to take
advantage of the high vapour pressure ratio between
liquid hydrogen and liquid deuterium. Deuterium can be
fractionated from liquid hydrogen with a considerable
separation efficiency.

Digital Analog Computation (Tech)/TechIn.Name: Digital Analog Computation
Digital Analog Computation (Tech)/TechIn.Description: To avoid wasting valuable computing power on useless matters, digital simulation enables analog computations via discrete electrical signals and outputs answers to complicated problems, much like a biological brain does.  Silicon-based neurons are a fundamental form of silicon-based life. If given a high degree of evolutionary freedom, they may evolved into a new "Dark Fog". Warning: This technology has been prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.

Dirac Inversion Mechanism (Tech)/TechInf.Name: Dirac_Inversion_Mechanism
Dirac Inversion Mechanism (Tech)/TechInf.Description: During the research of the Dirac equation in reverse, it discovers that a large number of gamma rays can create an open string in a critical vibration state, and they will easily split into proton and antiproton pairs when they collide mutually. Mastering this technology will improve the ray receiver's efficiency, store the energy of stars as antimatter.

Distribution Logistics System (Tech)/Tec.Name: Distribution Logistics System
Distribution Logistics System (Tech)/Tec.Description: Through Logistics Distributor and Logistics Bots, transporting items between storage and Icarus can be accomplished on the same planet. They can also transport items between storages those are on this planet.

Dyson Sphere Program (Tech)/TechInfo&act.Name: Dyson Sphere Program
Dyson Sphere Program (Tech)/TechInfo&act.Description:
Welcome to the Dyson Sphere Program!
You will start from scratch with a small workshop, develop into a huge intergalactic industrial empire, and finally build the great miracle of the universe: The Dyson Sphere.

Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.Name: Dyson Sphere Stress System
Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.L1Description: As the latitude of the Dyson sphere nodes increases, its surface stress distribution will become more complicated and will be more difficult to maintain the balance of its stress system
Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.L2Description: As the latitude of the Dyson sphere nodes increases, its surface stress distribution will become more complicated and will be more difficult to maintain the balance of its stress system
Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.L3Description: As the latitude of the Dyson sphere nodes increases, its surface stress distribution will become more complicated and will be more difficult to maintain the balance of its stress system
Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.L4Description: As the latitude of the Dyson sphere nodes increases, its surface stress distribution will become more complicated and will be more difficult to maintain the balance of its stress system
Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.L5Description: As the latitude of the Dyson sphere nodes increases, its surface stress distribution will become more complicated and will be more difficult to maintain the balance of its stress system
Dyson Sphere Stress System (Tech)/TechIn.L6Description: As the latitude of the Dyson sphere nodes increases, its surface stress distribution will become more complicated and will be more difficult to maintain the balance of its stress system

Electromagnetic Drive (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Electromagnetic Drive
Electromagnetic Drive (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Unlocks the basic power system component: Electric
Motor

Electromagnetic Matrix/TechInfo.Name: Electromagnetic Matrix
Electromagnetic Matrix/TechInfo.Description: The Electromagnetic Matrix is the foundation of all technologies and one of the basic source codes that keep the CentreBrain simulating. Use a Matrix Lab to create these matrices and use a separate lab for automating the research of new technologies.

Electromagnetic Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Electromagnetic Matrix
Electromagnetic Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
The Electromagnetic Matrix is the foundation of all
technologies and one of the basic source codes that
keep the CentreBrain simulating. Use a Matrix Lab to
create these matrices and use a separate lab for
automating the research of new technologies.

Electromagnetism (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Electromagnetism
Electromagnetism (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Maxwell's equations poetically describe electricity and
magnetism intertwining. With a deeper understanding,
machines can be created for acquiring and using
electrical energy with high efficiency.

Energy Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Energy Matrix
Energy Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
One of the five basic source codes that keep the
CentreBrain simulating. Continue uploading the Energy
Matrix to unlock more advanced energy technologies.

Energy Storage (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Energy Storage
Energy Storage (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Use {{Glow|Accumulator}} to store the surplus electrical energy
in the power grid. When the power supply is
insufficient, the accumulator will automatically release
the stored electric energy to maintain the factory
operating.

Engine (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Engine
Engine (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Unlocks the basic aircraft component: Engine

Environment Modification (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Environment Modification
Environment Modification (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Collect soil pile from above zero altitudes and use them
to fill up the ocean to make the factory construction
more convenient. Just rectify the surface will consume
the foundation.

Explosive Unit (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Explosive Unit
Explosive Unit (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: A classic chemical formula. After reaction conditions and raw material ratios have been optimized, reliable explosives can be made and casually handled.

Fluid Storage Encapsulation (Tech)/TechI.Name: Fluid Storage Encapsulation
Fluid Storage Encapsulation (Tech)/TechI.Description:
This technology can encapsulate the fluid in the
container, making transportation more convenient.

Gas Giants Exploitation (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Gas Giants Exploitation
Gas Giants Exploitation (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Gas giants contain abundant resources, and the exploitation of Gas giants makes a new level of technology.

Geothermal Extraction (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Geothermal Extraction
Geothermal Extraction (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The magma of the lava planet contains enourmous energy, and if you master the technology of geothermal extraction, you can completely capture this energy.

Gravitational Wave Refraction (Tech)/Tec.Name: Gravitational Wave Refraction
Gravitational Wave Refraction (Tech)/Tec.Description: The Graviton Lens made of strange matter can produce a particular range of spatial distortion near the lens through ingenious design, which will refract the passing graviton.

Gravity Matrix/TechInfo.Name: Gravity Matrix
Gravity Matrix/TechInfo.Description: One of the basic source codes that keep the CentreBrain simulating, through the study of the Gravity Matrix, finally reconciled Quantum Field Theory and General Relativity.

Gravity Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Gravity Matrix
Gravity Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: One of the basic source codes that keep the CentreBrain simulating, through the study of the Gravity Matrix, finally reconciled Quantum Field Theory and General Relativity.

High-Density Controlling Annihilation (T.Name: High-Density Controlling Annihilation
High-Density Controlling Annihilation (T.Description: The mass of Strange Matter is much higher than that of hydrogen, so if it is used as the raw material for the annihilation reaction, we will be abled to obtain more efficient energy sources. The Strange Matter will convert matter to strange matter on contact and this process is uncontrolled. What about converting antimatter to strange antimatter? It only exists in rumors. Warning: This technology has ben prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.

High-Efficiency Logistics System (Tech)/.Name: High-Efficiency Logistics System
High-Efficiency Logistics System (Tech)/.Description:
Sorter MK.III can sort cargo even faster, very useful
when resources in great demand.

High-Efficiency Plasma Control (Tech)/Te.Name: High-Efficiency Plasma Control
High-Efficiency Plasma Control (Tech)/Te.Description:
Through the use of electric and magnetic fields, plasma
can be utilized more efficiently. Plasma Exciters are
very stable and effective.

High-Explosive Shell Set (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: High-Explosive Shell Set
High-Explosive Shell Set (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The newer shells require higher explosive capacity and greater stability.

High-Speed Assembling Processes (Tech)/T.Name: High-Speed Assembling Processes
High-Speed Assembling Processes (Tech)/T.Description:
The upgraded assembler has improved the production
speed and can assemble items faster.

High-Strength Crystal (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: High-Strength Crystal
High-Strength Crystal (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Further strengthen the crystalline lattice structure of
titanium atoms by mixing it with precise proportions of
organic crystal to obtain Titanium crystal.

High-Strength Glass (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: High-Strength Glass
High-Strength Glass (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Incorporating a specific proportion of titanium and organic crystals into molten glass can create high-strength Titanium Glass which is suitable for more complex industrial production.

High-Strength Lightweight Structure (Tec.Name: High-Strength Lightweight Structure
High-Strength Lightweight Structure (Tec.Description: Compared with the traditional structure, the new high-strength frame material is made of carbon nanotubes, which can withstand the strong gravitational force of stars.

High-Strength Material (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: High-Strength Material
High-Strength Material (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Objects made of Carbon Nanotubes that are harder than diamond can maintain structural integrity better when subjected to greater pressure. This is very practical for industrial production that requires withstanding extremely high pressure.

High-Strength Titanium Alloy (Tech)/Tech.Name: High-Strength Titanium Alloy
High-Strength Titanium Alloy (Tech)/Tech.Description: Taking advantage of the characteristics of the lattice structure of titanium at different temperatures, adding precise proportions of alloy elements during the smelting process, will produce a new type of alloy material that with higher strength and better toughness.

Hydrogen Fuel Rod (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Hydrogen Fuel Rod
Hydrogen Fuel Rod (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
With further development of cryo-technology hydrogen
can be liquefied to make fuel rods with higher energy.
These higher energy Hydrogen Fuel Rods can greatly
increase the mecha's fuel power.

Implosion Cannon (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Implosion Cannon
Implosion Cannon (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: After precise calculation, Combustible Units are specially distributed in a shell to trigger aggregated explosions. Since explosive products and energy are concentrated ,the damage inflicted is greater.

Improved Logistics System (Tech)/TechInf.Name: Improved Logistics System
Improved Logistics System (Tech)/TechInf.Description:
{{Glow|Splitter(4-direction)}} can diverge cargo or balance
multiple conveyor belts, making the automated
production lines more diverse.
Use {{kbd|Tab}} key to switch styles.

Information Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Information Matrix
Information Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Immediate and effective information transmission greatly optimize the industrial production process. By uploading the information Matrix to obtain more technologies, it is helpful to improve the information management of automated production line.

Integrated Logistics System (Tech)/TechI.Name: Integrated Logistics System
Integrated Logistics System (Tech)/TechI.Description: With a deeper understanding of material structures, the Integrated Logistics technology has now improved and increased the carrying capacity of Conveyor Belts by combining two successive objects on a Conveyor Belt into one.

Interstellar Logistics System (Tech)/Tec.Name: Interstellar Logistics System
Interstellar Logistics System (Tech)/Tec.Description: The magnificent space elevator realizes more convenient transportation of materials between planets.

Interstellar Power Transmission (Tech)/T.Name: Interstellar Power Transmission
Interstellar Power Transmission (Tech)/T.Description: Using the Energy Exchanger, the surplus electric energy in the grid can be made into a full accumulator, transported to another planet, and then released through the energy exchanger. Realize the transportation of electricity between planets.

Magnetic Levitation (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Magnetic Levitation
Magnetic Levitation (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
The magnetic force generated by the electromagnetic
turbine can make objects levitate against gravity.

Magnetic Particle Trap (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Magnetic Particle Trap
Magnetic Particle Trap (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
When material technology reaches a certain level, the
particles can be behind by devices. Particles can also be
guided to show certain properties.

Matter Recombination (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Matter Recombination
Matter Recombination (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Matter Recombinator re-composes raw materials at particle size to massively accelerate manufacturing speed. Yet these core components can only be obtained from high-level Dark Fog Debris. Matter Recombinator can replicate any product if the recipe is correct. Organisms, abiotic entities, Dark Fog... Maybe it can replicate itself. Warning: This technology has been prohibited by the COSMO Technology Ethics Committee. Please initiate such research manually.

Mesoscopic Quantum Entanglement (Tech)/T.Name: Mesoscopic Quantum Entanglement
Mesoscopic Quantum Entanglement (Tech)/T.Description: With the support of computing power of quantum chips, strange matter can be distributed to specific points. Then the entanglement effect of a single quantum can be amplified to the macromolecular level. With this technology, subverting the traditional chemical engineering is just a "drop by".

Mini Fusion Power Generation (Tech)/Tech.Name: Mini Fusion Power Generation
Mini Fusion Power Generation (Tech)/Tech.Description: By using stellerator structure to confine static high-temperature plasma reactor core, the new generation of controlled nuclear fusion technology put standard fuel rod to supply deuterium; these technological breakthroughs promote the miniaturization of reactor miniaturization.

Miniature Particle Collider (Tech)/TechI.Name: Miniature Particle Collider
Miniature Particle Collider (Tech)/TechI.Description: The construction of a Miniature Particle Collider requires advanced materials and a huge energy supply. It is expensive, but it is worth it

Missile Turret (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Missile Turret
Missile Turret (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: With an advanced identification and position system, a Missile Turret can precisely hit ground and space units, and can also defend a base in an all-around way. Although its structure is complicated, it's very practical.

Mission Completed! (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Mission Completed!
Mission Completed! (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Congratulations! Builder of great civilizations! The primary mission of the Dyson Sphere Program has been successfully complete with your efforts. (The game will continue after completion)

Particle Control (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Particle Control
Particle Control (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Although it is profound and complicated, it is of great benefit to master particle control technology. Under precise conditions, particle can be made to have a certain regularity and when they do they become much easier to control.

Photon Frequency Conversion (Tech)/TechI.Name: Photon Frequency Conversion
Photon Frequency Conversion (Tech)/TechI.Description:
The Photon Combiner can convert low-frquency
photons into high-frequency, effectively reducing solar
energy loss from solar radiation.

Photon Spotlight Mining (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Photon Spotlight Mining
Photon Spotlight Mining (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Under a special gravitational field, the quantum chip could be used to positively intervene in the transition process of the photon group. It can control the propagation path and produce an obvious bunching effect. This high-energy laser beam can instantly cut the ore veins and transform the ores into particles for transportation and packaging, which significantly improves the efficiency of mining.

Plane-Filter Smelting (Tech).Name: Plane-Filter Smelting
Plane-Filter Smelting (Tech).Description: Research shows that a thermodynamic negative temperature flow can be generated if the quantum state of monopoles is filtered by Wave Function Interference Technology. Using this technology, the process of ores smelting or purification can be greatly accelerated.

Planetary Defense System (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Planetary Defense System
Planetary Defense System (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: How should we respond to a herd of enemies? Use Planetary Shield Generator to build a solid barrier for the whole planet! It's worth a try, through massive energy will be consumed.  You must prepare for enemies from deep space.

Planetary Ionosphere Utilization (Tech)/.Name: Planetary Ionosphere Utilization
Planetary Ionosphere Utilization (Tech)/.Description: With the Graviton Lens, it can increase the ray receiver's maximum output power by utilizing the planetary ionosphere. Of course, the premise is that the planet has an atmosphere, or this technology is useless.
Planetary Ionosphere Utilization (Tech)/.UnlockText: Allow ray receiver to consume Graviton lens to increase the max output power

Planetary Logistics System (Tech)/TechIn.Name: Planetary Logistics System
Planetary Logistics System (Tech)/TechIn.Description: The planetary transportation can be realized through Logistic Station and Logistic drone after the materials technology reaches a certain level. The logistics drones will automatically transport the items after the supply-demand data is setup.

Plasma Extract Refining (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Plasma Extract Refining
Plasma Extract Refining (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Applying new knowledge of plasma technology enables
efficient gathering and refining of Crude Oil which will
rapidly facilitate industrial development.

Plasma Turret (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Plasma Turret
Plasma Turret (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Through stimulation of electric fields and control of magnetic fields, gaseous substances are ionized to form a rapidly moving plasma flow and achieved the ability to inflict major damage.

Polymer Chemical Engineering (Tech)/Tech.Name: Polymer Chemical Engineering
Polymer Chemical Engineering (Tech)/Tech.Description:
Processing refined oil and plastic with a new polymer
synthesis technology will create a new material:
Organic Crystal.

Precision Drone (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Precision Drone
Precision Drone (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Power and Weapons systems are enhanced based on a modified prototype to give them a longer range and faster speed.

Processor (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Processor
Processor (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Large-scale integrated circuit devices are very good at
processing data and managing the procedure.

Proliferator Mk.III (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Proliferator Mk.III
Proliferator Mk.III (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The changes brought about by the application of the Proliferator to the entire industrial production are obvious to all. After seeing such an amazing change, it is imperative to make a more advanced Proliferator. With the persistent improvement of material technology and manufacturing process, the Proliferator MK.III was invented, and its effect is more outstanding. Of course, it also comes with higher requirement for production line design.

Proliferator Mk.II (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Proliferator Mk.II
Proliferator Mk.II (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The Proliferator MK.II has upgraded the formula, and the effect of Extra Products or Production Speedup has been further improved.

Proliferator Mk.I (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Proliferator Mk.I
Proliferator Mk.I (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The advent of the Proliferator has made a great change to the entire manufacturing. When it is sprayed to the cargos, an Extra Products gain or Production Speedup effect will occur.

Prototype (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Prototype
Prototype (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: In addition to Turrets in fixes areas, Icarus also needs some active means to launch attack.  A simply built Combat Drone would be its best partner.

Quantum Chip (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Quantum Chip
Quantum Chip (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Quantum chip can interfere with the wave function during the quantum transition process according to the quantum state's Rabi oscillation, increasing the probability of particles appearing in some states.

Quantum Printing (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Quantum Printing
Quantum Printing (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: We can control the arrangement and combination of particles in 3D space from a more microscopic level using quantum printing technology, which maximizes production speed.

Ray Receiver (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Ray Receiver
Ray Receiver (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Receiving the high-energy rays transmitted from the Dyson Sphere and directly outputting energy to the power grid. Ray receiving efficiency will affect the energy obtained.

Reformed Refinement (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Reformed Refinement
Reformed Refinement (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: With the development of chemical science, it is now possible to add hydrogen and coal to Crude Oil, and process more Crude Oil through reforming reaction.

Reinforced Thruster (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Reinforced Thruster
Reinforced Thruster (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Advanced power devices, can drive logistics vessel to transport goods among planets.

Satellite Power Distribution System (Tec.Name: Satellite Power Distribution System
Satellite Power Distribution System (Tec.Description: Using the powerful magnetic field excited by the super-magnetic ring, there is a longer power transmission distance and a larger supply area.

Semiconductor Material (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Semiconductor Material
Semiconductor Material (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Microcrystalline component with semiconductive
properties is an excellent material for manufacturing
processor.

Signal Tower (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Signal Tower
Signal Tower (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Long-term research found that Dark Fog is especially sensitive to certain wave bands of signals. Maybe this can be used to produce a facility that triggers Dark Fog's hatred and induces it for a targeted attack.

Smelting Purification (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Smelting Purification
Smelting Purification (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
The development of smelting process has given rise to
ore purification technology, which can help to obtain
purer and more advanced products.

Solar Collection (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Solar Collection
Solar Collection (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
The sun continuously radiates energy outwards in the
form of electromagnetic waves. Laying solar panels can
collect these radiant energy, but it is a small part. We
need a more efficient way.

Solar Sail Orbit System (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Solar Sail Orbit System
Solar Sail Orbit System (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Use {{Glow|[[EM-Rail Ejector]]}} to projectile {{Glow|[[Solar Sail|Solar sails]]}} will form a
Dyson swarm to absorb radiation energy from the star
more effectively.

Steel Smelting (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Steel Smelting
Steel Smelting (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Under extremely strict and controllable temperature
conditions, using a smelter to smelt iron ingots will
improve the crystal form of materials further, can
obtain better mechanical properties.

Strange Matter (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Strange Matter
Strange Matter (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Under the powerful energy of deuterium fusion, iron vapor is compressed to an extremely small size which causes the quark's of the iron core to change and instantly degenerate into strange matter.

Structure Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Structure Matrix
Structure Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The Structure Matrix is one of the basic source codes that keep the CentreBrain simulating. Continue uploading these matrices to better understand the structure of matter and to unlock new technologies.

Super Magnetic Field Generator (Tech)/Te.Name: Super Magnetic Field Generator
Super Magnetic Field Generator (Tech)/Te.Description:
Generating high-intensity and stable artificial magnetic
fields is very difficult, but it is crucial for developing
other advanced technologies. Mastering super magnetic
field technology is essential in the development of
technology.

Superalloy Ammo Box (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Superalloy Ammo Box
Superalloy Ammo Box (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The shape and structure of shell cases are what determine the speed and penetrability of bullets. How does one achieve a higher initial speed and a steadier flight performance? A high-intensity, low-density titanium alloy is the optimal material. Let the bullets fly further!

Supersonic Missile Set (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Supersonic Missile Set
Supersonic Missile Set (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: More precise control and propulsion systems enable higher levels of accuracy and greater attack capabilities for missiles.

Thermal Power (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Thermal Power
Thermal Power (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
Power generation facilities that use combustibles as
fuel have a conversion rate between energy output and
fuel consumed.

Thruster (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Thruster
Thruster (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
A high efficiency engine that operates plasma jets at
hyperspeed to create a strong counterforce which can
drive logistics drones to transport cargo between
planetary logistic stations.

Titanium Ammo Box (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Titanium Ammo Box
Titanium Ammo Box (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Since this involves Dark Fog, sharper warheads are required to pierce enemies' armor. Magnum Ammo Boxes that have been improved with titanium ingots will inflict greater damage.

Titanium Smelting (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Titanium Smelting
Titanium Smelting (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
The advancement in mining and smelting technology
have made ore control easier. Titanium can now be
minied and utilized.

Universe Matrix/TechInfo.Name: Universe Matrix
Universe Matrix/TechInfo.Description: The Universe Matrix contains everything, matter, energy, and information. It turns out, that these are all the same thing. It is the ultimate crystallization of the theory of everything, revealing the ultimate mystery of the universe.

Universe Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Universe Matrix
Universe Matrix (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: The Universe Matrix contains everything, matter, energy, and information. It turns out, that these are all the same thing. It is the ultimate crystallization of the theory of everything, revealing the ultimate mystery of the universe.

Vertical Launching Silo (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Vertical Launching Silo
Vertical Launching Silo (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Use [[Small Carrier Rocket|Small Carrier Rocket]] to launch the [[Dyson Sphere Component|Dyson Sphere Components]] to form the Dyson sphere frames and nodes.

Wave Function Interference (Tech)/TechIn.Name: Wave Function Interference
Wave Function Interference (Tech)/TechIn.Description: Mastering the regularity of the probability change in teh quantum transition process can execute a series of reverse  interference to the wave function of the particle thereby increasing the certainty of its collapse. Making good use of this technology may be a good thing for cats.

Weapon System (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: Weapon System
Weapon System (Tech)/TechInfo.Description: Once weapons appear, the tables are turned. Icarus has what it needs to fight Dark Fog and guard the base, and it can calmly respond to raids as well.

X-ray Cracking (Tech)/TechInfo.Name: X-Ray Cracking
X-ray Cracking (Tech)/TechInfo.Description:
High-energy X-ray photocatalysis can crack refined oil
into more hydrogen and process the byproducts into
energeric graphite.
